headline: Public hearings on wetland permits for projects at Magnolia Avenue, Wingaersheek Road, Concord Street, and other sites, plus shoreline violation reviews.
summary: The Conservation Commission will review continued and new Notices of Intent for construction projects near wetlands and coastal areas, along with certificates of compliance and enforcement orders for violations at several properties.
